source: HugoXK/fledge#94 (rendered wide header), #133 (collapsed phone header) and #233 (the same collapsed row at 641-960px)
method: The wide value is a rendered measurement from #94: document.querySelector('.top').offsetHeight in Chromium, over the 46 + 28 renders recorded there (locale and default-font-size variants), tallest at 1280. The two compact values are not rendered maxima: #133 and #233 give the header a fixed height at or below 960px, a 64px row plus the 1px bottom border of .top, so no locale, label or default font size can grow them. The rendered confirmation at 360/390/430 (phone) and 641/768/900/960 (tablet, both locales, logged in) is the matrix #133 and #233 ask Test to run at the tip.
